base_amount_policy.no_fallback: Never infer, discover, or fall back to $50.00 or any broker/account default base amount. The base is fixed at exactly $3.00.

risk_guard.description: Dynamic risk guard. A rolling 30-day cash-burn rate is tracked for visibility. When capital deployed in any trailing 7-day window exceeds kill_switch_7d_deploy_fraction (40%) of monthly_cash_allocation_usd, the graded ladder is capped at 1x: the strategy keeps buying dips at the base amount but stops scaling up until the 7-day window rolls back under the threshold. Deployment is counted only from scheduled-live afternoon evidence (run_origin='scheduled', manual_run=false, timestamp at/after 2:30 PM ET); manual and other streams are excluded. See docs/risk_management.md and dca_risk.py.

budget_tiers.name: stress
budget_tiers.note: Usable only to the extent prior unused weekly rollover reserve is available.

selection_rule: Pick the highest tier triggered by EITHER planned spend or the count of 3x-or-greater signals. A 3x-or-greater signal is a buy candidate whose ladder multiplier is >= 3.0.
allocation_priority: Prioritize allocations by higher multiplier first, then larger percent drop, then ticker (alphabetical) for a deterministic tie-break. Flag any capped tickers.

robinhood.note: Only execution broker/account for live and manual runs.

alpaca.note: Read-only validation and account context only; never execution unless explicitly changed later.

safety_policy: No sells, options, crypto, margin changes, account modifications, or order cancellations unless explicitly requested later. Buys only, regular market hours only, one strategy order per ticker per day.
hard_limits: Never exceed the selected daily cap, the selected weekly cap, available buying power, or the broker/order-review limit. Caps are absolute ceilings; when a rule and an order conflict, the order is skipped.
